text_block_list.text:
Displaying overwhelming speed, Daiichi 
Ruby seizes victory. In her running, K.S. 
Miracle witnesses the ultimate brilliance.

Vowing to keep running and show everyone 
the future, KS Miracle asks her for a 
rematch at the Swan Stakes.

Just then, Daitaku Helios barged in. 
Praising the two for their valiant 
efforts, she invited them to the Mile 
Championship to decide the mile champion.

Looking forward to honing herself against 
formidable rivals, Daiichi Ruby sets the 
Mile Championship as her major goal.

Impressed by Daiichi Ruby's resolve to 
reach even greater heights, the Trainer 
firmly decided to deliver results 
befitting her trainer.
